category_title: Young adults with intellectual disabilities who exhibit passive agreement and chronic lateness
scenario_title: Initial Goal Setting and Waking Day Interview
minimal_context: Michael is in an IEP meeting with his teacher, job coach, mother, and program supervisor to discuss setting a goal for finishing tasks without stopping so much.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Michael, we would like to develop some goals with you. Your job coach says you have a tendency to pay more attention to what others are doing and can lose focus on what you need to be doing. Do you think that working on finishing tasks without stopping so much would be a good goal to work on?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Your mom mentioned that you do the same thing at home, messing around in the morning instead of doing your job. So that is something that you could work on at both school and home.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Do you think it is a problem, Michael?

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Michael, we would like to develop some goals with you. Your job coach says you have a tendency to pay more attention to what others are doing and can lose focus on what you need to be doing. Do you think that working on finishing tasks without stopping so much would be a good goal to work on?

STUDENT: Sure.

TUTOR: Your mom mentioned that you do the same thing at home, messing around in the morning instead of doing your job. So that is something that you could work on at both school and home.

STUDENT: Yeah, okay.

TUTOR: Do you think it is a problem, Michael?

STUDENT: I don't know. Maybe.

task.content: working on finishing tasks without stopping so much

context.social_setting: teacher, job coach, mother, and program supervisor

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When asked if his behavior is a problem
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: respond automatically in order to please the teacher or parents, reduce the pressure to respond, or avoid cognitive complexity

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: agrees or disagrees automatically, with little reflection on their response
